description: This Java class 'DescriptionProcessor' processes various object types (HttpRequest, OpenAPIDefinition, DashboardLogEntryDTO) to generate descriptive representations and tracks maximum length metrics for different description types within the mockserver dashboard context.

classes.name: DescriptionProcessor
classes.description: A class that generates descriptive representations of various object types and tracks maximum description lengths for logging and API documentation purposes.

methods.name: getMaxHttpRequestLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum length of HTTP request descriptions processed.

methods.name: getMaxOpenAPILength
methods.description: Returns the maximum length of OpenAPI definition descriptions processed.

methods.name: getMaxOpenAPIObjectLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum length of OpenAPI object descriptions processed.

methods.name: getMaxLogEventLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum length of log message descriptions processed.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Generates a description object for the given object, optionally with an ID prefix.
